inputPlans.name: Input fields plan advancements
inputPlans.hint: A value typed into the character sheet's fields for skills, combat techniques, spells, liturgies, attribute or base stat advances plans the needed advancements instead of setting the value directly. The GM can still set it directly with Ctrl+Enter. Switch this off while building characters.

phaseEnabled.name: Use an advancement phase
phaseEnabled.hint: Players can plan anytime, but advancing (applying planned steps, + and - on the sheet, setting values directly) and sending requests only works while the GM has the advancement phase open. The GM is never held back.

phaseOpen.name: Advancement phase open
phaseOpen.hint: Whether players may advance right now. Can also be switched in the planner overview and only takes effect together with "Use an advancement phase".
